headline: Approved a tax abatement for 1089 Dexter Street and the 2026-2027 liquor and business license renewals.
summary: Council approved the previous meeting's minutes, a license transfer for Sparky's Restaurant, and a peddler license for One Fly Stop. It tabled Michael Calderon's peddler application because the business owner was not present.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 15, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Tabled the peddler application of Michael Calderon, D/B/A MC Varieties, 5-0.
Approved the peddler application of Yessenia Rodriguez, D/B/A One Fly Stop, 5-0.
Approved the A-Restaurant license transfer to Fernando Ixcoy Zacarias, D/B/A Sparky's Restaurant, 5-0.
Approved the 2026-2027 liquor license renewals as a bundle, 5-0.
Approved the 2026-2027 business license renewals as a bundle, 5-0.
Approved a 2026 tax abatement for Pink Capital, LLC, for 1089 Dexter St., 5-0.
